text: This run looked at the token-factory page with no buyer or goal specified. In the hero (the saved copy from 2026-11-15), question A4-cta failed because the main button does not tell the reader what happens when clicked. The writer tried three angles: Variant A focused on an India-served data path, Variant B on enterprise uptime, and Variant C on one key. Both Jev and Judge 2 rated Variant A better than the saved hero, but held it for a person to check. Variant B and Variant C failed Gate 2 because other question scores dropped, though Variant C was a near miss.
